scripts.mobile:sync-openapi: turbo run build --filter=api && pnpm --filter api openapi:export
scripts.mobile:test: pnpm mobile:generate && xcodebuild test -project apps/mobile/StravaClone.xcodeproj -scheme StravaClone -skipPackagePluginValidation -only-testing:StravaCloneTests -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17'
scripts.mobile:test:ui: pnpm mobile:generate && xcodebuild test -project apps/mobile/StravaClone.xcodeproj -scheme StravaClone -skipPackagePluginValidation -only-testing:StravaCloneUITests -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17'
